items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: my uncle Gus just died here about three years ago

ctx.x: And all of your aunts and uncles are dead now? Every one of them, even the in-laws. They're all dead.
My aunts, you know, my uncle's wives. I have one aunt that's living in Berkeley, California, where my uncle Gus just died here about three years ago, and she's nearly 80 herself. Yeah.
That was by- she was by Mary. Yes, that would be by Mary.
